overall.headline: Thunderstorms and flood advisories hit Pacifica today; Iran attacks Kuwait and Bahrain after a US strike.
overall.bluf: NWS has a Severe Thunderstorm Warning for San Mateo County until 11 AM, a Flood Advisory until 11:45 AM and a Wind Advisory until 1 PM, with 3/4 to 1 inch more rain today and thunderstorms again tonight. A High Surf Advisory starts at 4 PM and runs to early Friday. Abroad, Kuwait and Bahrain say they were attacked by Iran after a US strike on Qeshm Island, and Trump, Xi and Putin meet in Shenzhen on Thursday. No FEMA emergency alerts are active for Pacifica.

local.note: Thunderstorm warning, flood and wind advisories.

regional.note: Sierra winter storm warnings; flood watches south.

world.note: Iran hits Kuwait, Bahrain; Trump-Xi-Putin talks.

changes: New: NWS issued a Severe Thunderstorm Warning for San Mateo County (until 11 AM) and a Flood Advisory for San Mateo, San Francisco and Santa Cruz counties (until 11:45 AM).
Updated: The High Surf Advisory now runs from 4 PM today to 4 AM Friday (earlier notices said Thursday 4 PM). Forecast rain today is 3/4 to 1 inch, with thunderstorms again tonight.
Updated: Kuwait says it repelled Iran's first attack in two months, and Bahrain was also attacked, after a US strike on Iran's Qeshm Island on Tuesday.
New: Trump shook hands with Putin and Xi in China today; the three-way talks are Thursday.
New: Israeli forces began a new operation in central Gaza, west of the Yellow Line.
New: Homeland Security Secretary Mullin is testifying to Congress today on cyber and tech disruptions.

Dropped as stale: Yemen/Houthi offensive, measles status, Iran 'dirty bomb' claim, Japan airspace incursion and Hwy 1 Moss Beach/Pescadero work (now listed for Thursday only), because there are no reports in the last 36 hours or the notice has passed.

coming_up.title: High Surf Advisory on the coast
coming_up.detail: Stay off beaches, rocks and jetties.

coming_up.title: More thunderstorms tonight, then rain Thursday
coming_up.detail: Another 3/4 to 1 inch tonight; 1/4 to 1/2 inch Thursday with gusts to 29 mph. Mostly dry Friday.

coming_up.title: Trump, Xi and Putin three-way meeting in Shenzhen
coming_up.detail: NPR and BBC say the talks follow the leaders' handshake today; APEC runs Nov 18–19.

coming_up.title: Winter Storm Warnings, Sierra and Siskiyou
coming_up.detail: Tahoe, Mono, Yosemite and Sequoia areas run to Friday 4 AM; Shasta and Siskiyou to Thursday 4 AM. Mountain travel will be difficult.

coming_up.title: Hwy 1 one-way traffic at Moss Beach and near Pescadero
coming_up.detail: Caltrans lists drainage and slide-repair work on Thursday; expect delays south of Pacifica.

coming_up.title: I-280 full closures in San Francisco for bridge work
coming_up.detail: Caltrans lists full closures Nov 20–21 and 21–22; plan alternate routes into the city.

home_front.summary: Thunderstorm warning, flood and wind advisories; no FEMA alerts.

items.title: Thunderstorms, flooding and wind in Pacifica today and tonight
items.detail: NWS has a Severe Thunderstorm Warning for San Mateo County until 11 AM, a Flood Advisory until 11:45 AM and a Wind Advisory until 1 PM (gusts to about 37 mph). Another 3/4 to 1 inch of rain is forecast today and again tonight, on saturated ground.
items.action: Stay off flooded roads ('turn around, don't drown'), avoid the coast and low spots on Hwy 1, keep phones and power banks charged, and clear the storm drain near the house before tonight's rain.

items.title: High Surf Advisory from 4 PM today to 4 AM Friday
items.detail: NWS says swimmers should stay out of the water and off jetties, piers and rocks; never turn your back on the ocean. A Beach Hazards Statement runs until 4 PM.

home_front.summary: No Pacifica outage reports found; storm risk continues tonight.

items.title: Power outages possible in storm gusts and lightning
items.detail: I found no reported PG&E outage in Pacifica this morning; web searches returned only older storms. Gusts and thunderstorms on saturated ground can still bring down lines, so the PG&E map is the live source.
items.action: If power fails, report it at pge.com/outages, keep the fridge closed and use flashlights rather than candles.

home_front.summary: Flooding risk on wet roads; Hwy 1 work Thursday south of town.

items.title: Flooded roads possible; Hwy 1 low spots in heavy rain
items.detail: The Flood Advisory covers San Mateo County until 11:45 AM, and more heavy rain is forecast tonight. I found no verified Hwy 1 closure in Pacifica today; Caltrans lists one-way work at Moss Beach and near Pescadero on Thursday only.
items.action: If Hwy 1 floods or closes, use Skyline Blvd (Hwy 35) or Hwy 1 north to Daly City, and check QuickMap before leaving.

home_front.summary: Air quality good (AQI 39); no local advisories.

default.task: Check that flashlights have fresh batteries and the weather radio works.
default.why: Thunderstorms are forecast again tonight and rain continues Thursday.

3d.why: Heavy rain and wind can disrupt service or cause boil-water notices.

ladder.summary: Storm today; king tides later this month.

items.title: King tides expected next week
items.detail: KQED says the year's highest tides arrive next week and run through January, with possible coastal flooding. No new reports since Nov 17.

ladder.summary: Sierra winter storm; flood watches in the south.

items.title: Winter Storm Warnings for Sierra, Shasta and Siskiyou
items.detail: NWS warnings run to Friday 4 AM for Tahoe, Mono, Yosemite and Sequoia areas and to Thursday 4 AM for Shasta and Siskiyou. Flood Watches cover Santa Barbara, Ventura and Los Angeles-area coasts into Thursday.

items.title: Prosecutors ask state Supreme Court to block Newsom's death-sentence commutations
items.detail: CalMatters reported the request on Nov 16–17. No household action needed.

ladder.summary: Tech disruptions in Congress; Hindu temple plot charges.

items.title: Congress presses DHS on tech and cyber disruptions
items.detail: Homeland Security Secretary Mullin is testifying today on threats and the recent string of disruptions. Rubio said earlier there is no sign the US is under systemic attack, and Defense One reported a classified NSANet outage with no immediate sign of a cyberattack.
items.action: Keep some cash on hand and check balances through a second channel if your bank app fails.

items.title: Illinois man indicted on terrorism charges over foiled Hindu temple shooting plot
items.detail: A grand jury indicted a 19-year-old accused of planning a mass shooting at a temple in Aurora, Illinois, police said Wednesday. The plot was foiled; no household action needed.

items.title: Stocks flat after losing streak; oil and gold fall
items.detail: The S&P 500 fell 0.1% after a four-day losing streak, per AP. Brent crude is about $89 (down 4.2% on the day), gold fell 3.2% and the 10-year yield is 5.07%. The VIX and WTI feeds failed today.

ladder.summary: Crimea bridge aftermath; Putin to meet Trump and Xi.

items.title: Crimea bridge partly collapsed after Ukrainian attack
items.detail: NPR reports Putin will meet Trump and Xi Thursday while escaping the aftermath of the attack that partly collapsed the bridge. BBC reports Ukrainian forces fighting in an old Soviet tunnel in the Kharkiv region.
items.action: Watch for Russian retaliation and grain or energy price effects.

ladder.summary: Trump, Xi and Putin in Shenzhen.

items.title: Trump shakes hands with Putin and Xi ahead of three-way talks
items.detail: BBC reports the handshake today; the formal talks are Thursday at the APEC summit in Shenzhen. Reuters-sourced reports earlier said no agenda was set; Trump's side has cited Iran and nuclear arms.

ladder.summary: Iran hits Kuwait, Bahrain; new Gaza operation.

items.title: Iran attacks Kuwait and Bahrain after US strike on Qeshm Island
items.detail: Kuwait says it repelled Iran's first attack in two months and Bahrain says it was also attacked, after a US air strike on Qeshm Island on Tuesday (BBC, Al Jazeera). Gulf states condemned the attacks, and the Senate questioned the Navy today about Iran war costs.
items.action: If strikes widen, expect fuel and shipping effects; keep the car's tank at least half full.

items.title: Israeli forces launch new operation in central Gaza
items.detail: Al Jazeera reports troops advancing west of the Yellow Line, while billions pledged for Gaza rebuilding since the 2025 ceasefire have not led to rebuilding.
